Fit clone copy-number states

Source: R/clones_states.R
fit_clone_states.Rd

Per clone, a grid search over the depth contrast c (state mean c * log2(cn / base), base = the profile's copy-number baseline: the reference ploidy for pool-relative profiles, else 2; haploid windows (male chrX / chrY, ploidy 1) allow only nB = 0 states and their labels are relative to one copy; c >= 0.6 because absolute ploidy is unidentifiable: states are relative to the clone baseline), the orientation attenuation a (expected major fraction 0.5 + a * (f_state - 0.5)) and the window-level overdispersion rho. Emissions: Student-t (df) on the window log2 with scale = the window SE combined with the clone's systematic window noise and inflated for its autocorrelation (see clone_noise), and a two-sided robust beta-binomial on (nA, n_hap) (a 5 % component with 10x the overdispersion). The objective is the per-window mixture likelihood over the states with the grid prior weights.

Usage

fit_clone_states(
  profile,
  grid = cn_grid(),
  contrast = seq(0.6, 1, 0.05),
  atten = seq(0.6, 1, 0.05),
  rho = c(0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03),
  df = 5,
  eps = 0.02,
  refine = TRUE,
  p_switch = 0.001,
  min_win = 3
)

Arguments

profile

output of clone_profiles()

grid

state grid (cn_grid())

contrast

grid of depth contrasts

atten

grid of orientation attenuations

rho

grid of window-level overdispersions

df

degrees of freedom of the depth t

eps

allele error floor

refine

refine (c, a, rho) on the segment level: segment at the current fit (Viterbi, p_switch, min_win), then maximise the sum over segments of the best state's segment likelihood (depth on the precision-weighted segment mean, alleles summed over its windows); two passes

p_switch, min_win

segmentation parameters of the refinement (as segment_clone())

Value

list(ll = data.table clone, window, chrom, start, end, ploidy, state, label, ll (emission log-likelihood at the chosen parameters), windows = the profile with se_eff, par = data.table clone, c, a, rho, s_sys, loglik, grid)
